reviews.title: Missing Bottle from my order
reviews.text: I’ve been a happy customer of LB for years now and this is the first time I had to inquiry about a missing bottle (received four instead of five ordered). I know this can be just a candid mistake. But the post sale support is lacking. Makes me wonder of the customer care standards for LB these days. Good people. Good products. No reply to my emails.

reviews.title: Lost case of wine
reviews.text: FedEx lost a case of wine I purchased. I filed a claim with FedEx and reached out to LBW for assistance and have had one response that essentially said they’re too busy. They have not addressed my claim and loss with FedEx at all. Not buying from them again.

reviews.title: No customer service
reviews.text:
I had an order shipping to the wrong address and needed to change it.
Unfortunately after a half a dozen emails and 10 days later NO RESPONSE !
And guess what? When I called the office during regular business hours no one answered and you can’t even leave a voicemail. What a way to run a business !

reviews.title: No customer service
reviews.text: Customer service is non-existent and slow to fill orders and slow to process refunds.  Do not recommend!

reviews.title: Website is hijacked by third parties
reviews.text: The promise of Last Bottle is wines available at discounted prices. Unfortunately LB has switched to Shopify’s platform, which has enabled third parties to hijack offerings before they’re even released to the public. For instance, one app—winebuyerapp.com—chargers users $20/$30 to access Last Bottle’s online catalog of offerings through Shopify before the offerings are even released to the public. As a result, some of the best value wines with low inventory (like the collector bottles in the “power hour” of Last Bottle’s marathons) are sold out before they even appear on Last Bottle. This is an obvious security breach and something Last Bottle (and/or Shopify) should immediately resolve to protect their longtime customers.

reviews.title: What Customer Service
reviews.text: I made a mistake in shipping address and tried contacting them a few times on their “help” email address which is their only contact for customer service. No response at all. Silence.

reviews.title: App frequently doesn’t work
reviews.text: Like the last bottle website, the app needs a lot of work. It commonly does not share the current wine for sale specifically it almost always stops working during a marathon.  I’ve just learned not to use it.

reviews.title: Grand cru
reviews.text: My grand cru from st emilion - 6 bottles had started to turn.  No depth, thin, disappointing.  Win some lose some.

reviews.title: Shipping is a big problem
reviews.text: This app is legit. You do get the wines and can get some good deals. They say they ship in 3-5 business days. However, it’s 8 days since my last order as I write this and UPS still doesn’t have the shipment. You should plan on 4 weeks to get your package.

reviews.title: Disappointed new customer
reviews.text: I’m seeing one Wine come to the app per day. But when scrolling through Instagram, you have new wines added all the time.  So why is someone who’s download Your app and credit card information am I not receiving the same offers?

reviews.title: Sub-par Accuracy & Customer Service
reviews.text:
I have easily purchased over 100 bottles from LB, but lately they are failing their customer base in a significant way. Many of the wines here are over hyped, the descriptions are inaccurate, and they list conflicting vintage information for the same wine. Their communication is equally lacking as it takes weeks upon weeks to get a response to a question or concern (if you’re lucky enough to hear back from someone at all.) My last question took six weeks to get a response. The delivery process also mirrors their overall poor quality customer Example: They clearly state that you will automatically receive tracking information, however this email doesn’t arrive until after your order has already been delivered. Not much help to a busy professional. 

Unless you are ready and have the time to babysit your order, I cannot recommend this site.

reviews.title: Customer Service
reviews.text: It’s practically non existent.

reviews.title: Lost order-no response
reviews.text: I have been a consistent long time buyer from them. Spent $140 on an order I never received. Never responded to my many emails. Never refunded. AVOID this company! No response or help! So disappointed!

reviews.title: Nobody’s Home
reviews.text: I made my initial order almost a week ago. You can go on their app and check your order as well as the status. As nothing has changed since my order I became nervous as we only have a couple more weeks at the shipping location before moving to our summer home. I have sent 2 emails to the help desk asking about an approximate shipping date, and the possibility of changing the shipping address. Crickets!!  On the app it explains their policy on replying via the help desk, which has nothing to do with reality. I also found a phone number for them which was a Napa prefix but there’s a recording that says the number is no longer in use which is a bit concerning. Maybe it will work out and I’ll get a great deal on a great wine. Their customer service leaves a lot to be desired.

reviews.title: New App Regresses Features
reviews.text: The updated version of the app while ascetically an upgrade goes backwards in many functions. The old app was simple and easy to use. Checkout was less complex and order history showed pictures of the wines purchased on the main page not requiring you to click on every order to see the pictures which was useful to quickly reference prior purchases you liked to purchase again when they came up again. Most annoying the daily deal says not available during the Marathon when quick purchases are necessary to get the deals before they are gone, I’m relegated to the mobile web version which is even less user friendly than the app. I’m buying less wine due to the changes in the app,  it WAS my go to app for all Wine purchasing.

reviews.title: How About Customer Service
reviews.text: I ordered on 1/30.  After 10 days of no tracking info for my order I asked for an update, no response.  I asked the same on the app, no response.  I asked on one of your FaceBook ads, no response.

reviews.title: Good wines, terrible service
reviews.text: I ordered a number of wines from this company. Wines were decent for the most part. I received a shipment with broken bottles and despite writing them email 4 times, they completely ignored me. I would not recommend using them as they do not believe they need to respond to customers at all. I’ve ordered from multiple other online vendors who are far superior and actually respond. They purposefully do not have a service phone number as well.

reviews.title: App works fine, customer service is non responsive
reviews.text: I’m leaving this review in an effort to get some sort of response out of this company. To be clear, the app works fine and I’ve really enjoyed the service. However, on my latest shipment they shorted me by one bottle and I have emailed them separately four days in a row to get this handled and they are not responding. There is no one available at the phone number. They tell you to leave a message with all pertinent info and they will email you back.  I am so disappointed in this terrible failure in basic customer service. Up until now I’ve been thrilled with their service and have placed dozens of orders with them. This experience will certainly affect my willingness to do business with them again.

reviews.title: No wine yet
reviews.text: Although I received an email thanking me for ordering wine, none has shown up. I placed two orders about a month ago. I’ve sent emails and I called today and left a voicemail. I’ve gotten absolutely no communication from Last Bottle. I would like ANY communication at this point.

reviews.title: Order summary
reviews.text: Change is so we can see the bottle of wine in the order summary otherwise we have to way to tell which is which

reviews.title: App unusable
reviews.text: Every time I try to log in, it kicks me right out. It also doesn’t always get the latest “last bottle”. I have to go to the website to do anything. Please fix

reviews.title: Can’t login
reviews.text: I love their web-based service but have downloaded the app twice and am unable to type into the email & password fields. I don’t have this issue with any other app, so definitely not device-related.
